events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock's Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. Which artist or moment from the '69 event still resonates most for you?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the music world mourned the loss of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: It's 49 years since we lost Elvis Presley. His music and legend live on. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who left us 56 years ago today. His innovative guitar work continues to inspire generations. What's his most iconic riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road's Impact
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is as famous as the music within. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and songwriting continue to rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the inimitable Liam Gallagher! From Oasis to his solo work, his distinctive swagger is unmistakable.

events.title: Imagine UK Release Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod's Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and redefined portable music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, which 007 film or actor is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire millions around the world. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album's Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since the legendary Freddie Mercury left us. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
